label: Bundesagentur für Arbeit Jobsuche
terms_note: German PES job search (public API used by community clients); applications to the employer.

endpoints.call: api for search — the Bundesagentur für Arbeit Jobsuche REST service (https://rest.arbeitsagentur.de/jobboerse/jobsuche-service, header X-API-Key: jobboerse-jobsuche) that powers the BA's own app: GET
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: the endpoint is the BA app's backend documented by the bundesAPI community (OpenAPI on jobsuche.api.bund.dev / GitHub) — the BA publishes no developer terms or rate limits of its own; Public-sector data (Germany's largest vacancy database); the endpoint is the BA app's backend documented by the bundesAPI community (OpenAPI on jobsuche.api.bund.dev / GitHub) — the BA publishes no developer terms or rate limits of its own; the fixed client id 'jobboerse-jobsuche' is sent as X-API-Key. BA 'Rechtliche Hinweise' cover content liability only (separate terms may apply to registered services). Confid

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: The fixed public client id from https://jobsuche.api.bund.dev/ ('X-API-Key ist die clientId jobboerse-jobsuche'): set PLATFORM_MCP_ARBEITSAGENTUR_API_KEY=jobboerse-jobsuche. No registration exists; the BA publishes no developer terms of its own.

search.note: Bundesagentur für Arbeit job search (was = job-title free text, wo = place free text, page from 1, size = results per page). The OpenAPI's JobSearchResponse schema (stellenangebote[]/titel/arbeitgeber/refnr/arbeitsort) describes the /pc/v4/app/jobs variant, which answered 403 on 2026-09-24; the /pc/v6/jobs response read that day carries ergebnisliste[] with stellenangebotsTitel, firma, referenznummer (the docs: 'in /pc/v6/jobs die referenznummer'), stellenlokationen[].adresse, datumErsteVeroeffentlichung and gehaltsspanneVon/Bis (annual EUR when verguetungsangabe is JAHRESGEHALT). No posting URL or description is in the search hit; call get_posting. No published rate limit.

get_posting.note: Job details by encryptedJobCode: the docs define it as base64(refnr) ('Base64-kodierter Wert der refnr aus der Jobsuche'), so pass the search hit's referenznummer base64-encoded as id (e.g. 10001-1002716922-S -> MTAwMDEtMTAwMjcxNjkyMi1T). The mapped id is the plain referenznummer; description is the posting text (Markdown-like), arbeitgeberKundennummerHash (logo lookup) stays in raw.

not_offered.me: No account endpoint: the X-API-Key is the fixed public client id 'jobboerse-jobsuche', not a personal credential, and the OpenAPI lists only job search, job details and employer logo.
not_offered.apply: Page: 'applications to the employer' — the OpenAPI documents no application endpoint; candidates apply on arbeitsagentur.de or the employer site.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the OpenAPI documents job search, job details and the employer logo only.
